{{Quote|Their hero was humiliated - they'll look back on him with embarrassment. No new stories, no urban legends. The Jedi's days here are done.|Oniye Namada|<ref name="Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 2">[[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 2|''Purge – The Tyrant's Fist'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Oniye Namada''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] played an important role in the resolution of the [[Vaklin insurgency]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. With the help of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], she succeeded in her task to erase all traces of the presence of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on [[Vaklin]], despite the strong attachment of the people for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] cause. She had a [[Oniye Namada's daughter|daughter]] that she wanted to send to the [[Imperial Education Center]] on Vaklin.

==Biography==
Oniye Namada was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaklin]] as part of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Indeed, Vaklin was a world deeply-seated in pro-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] tradition. When the Empire asserted its control over the planet, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Cho'na Bene]] and two fellows, a [[Unidentified Jedi Master (Shrokaan)|Jedi Master]] and his [[Unidentified reptilian Jedi Knight|apprentice]], instigated an insurgency against the Empire. With the populace actively working against the Empire, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was dispatched to turn the people against the Jedi and put down the insurrection.

Oniye Namada carried out Darth Vader orders by questioned the locals of Vaklin what the statue was; then telling the Clone gunnery Team to destroy the statue of the Jedi Khen Reo. She then said "This empty Plaza will serve as the new site of an [[Imperial Education Center]] on Valkin. She strongly encouraged the people of Vaklin to enroll in the [[Imperial Education Center]]. She was in disguise as a clone trooper then publicly executing the Jedi in front of the Citizens so the Jedi would be humiliated.

==Skills and abilities==
Oniye Namada was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. She was good at manipulation, shown by when she humiliated the Jedi on Vaklin. Since she served in the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], she could crackdown on citizens who supported the Jedi or were affiliated with them. Lord Vader praised her because of her expertise during the Vakln Insurgency.

==Equipment==
Major Namada wore a white [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|Imperial uniform]] with a pair of black boots, she also wore a belt, on her head she wore a black cap. She wore an [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|rank insignia]] on on the left [[Breast/Legends|breast]] of her uniform. She was also an expert using the [[DC-15x sniper rifle/Legends|DC-15x sniper rifle]] when she shot Cho'na Bene in the throat killing him instantly.
